verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an API filter for chats "created by scheduled prompts," which implies Limitless has its own scheduled-prompt feature that runs Ask AI queries automatically without the user present. The feature itself is never documented beyond this one filter parameter. missing for 10: first-party docs on creating and configuring scheduled prompts or other automations, what triggers and actions are supported, whether they run fully in the background, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
